title: Large-Scale AI Development
description: I am interested in developing next-generation large language, multimodal, & reasoning models, and their applications to various professional domains and tasks.

title: Reasoning as Test-Time Learning
description: How can AI systems keep learning after deployment? I develop test-time learning methods that let models learn from new information and experience at inference time. My work reformulates reasoning as test-time learning, with applications to long-context and agentic AI systems.
